★Request
Symboli Rudolf walks into frame
Take 1st place with a lead of over 10 lengths.

...It would have been wonderful if I could still run around
innocently with her, just like back when I was truly her "older sister."

...A bolt from the blue. It is just as sudden for us,
though I imagine it is most of all so for you, Biwa Hayahide.
...Things have completely reversed from back then.

The academy was abuzz with talk of Narita Brian—and the unprecedented
feat of securing a slot in the Sprout Memorial prior to debut.
Lapse in judgment as it is, I forgot to tell you one important thing.

A gap opened in our physical abilities... and I could no longer catch up to my sister's back.
Panicked, all I did was reckless, unreasonable training.

This was a chance. If she competed in the Sprout Memorial where top racers gathered,
it would bring her much closer to perfecting her "formula for victory."

That was when I became obsessed with theory.
Since I couldn't move my body, my mind was the only thing left free.
...Forgive me. I lost my composure.
Shifted into the look of someone harboring determination and resolve.
Thinking that, I was about to encourage her to run, but—
Even so—even so, Trainer.

Biwa Hayahide gasped in astonishment.
Yet her expression gradually—
An important thing?

...I told you, it has never worked against Brian.
No matter what, I can never reach the victory beyond the equals sign!!

She always surpasses my theories. She always breaks my equations.
That's just the kind of out-of-bounds existence she is...!!

Indeed.
Biwa Hayahide, the one who strongly recommended you as a substitute was none other than—

Back then, I was undeniably captivated
by the "formula for victory" demonstrated by the Umamusume named Biwa Hayahide...!

Yes. Panicked by that receding back I couldn't reach no matter how hard I chased,
I failed to watch where I was going... crashed into a fence, and ended up hospitalized.

You look like you're in pain. Even though I constantly tell you
to take care of yourself, you always push yourself too hard...
...You yourself?

The Sprout Memorial exhibition race held at Tokyo Racecourse.
It is said that many legendary Umamusume first made their mark here.
A substitute runner...?
...It's an old story.

The one chosen as the substitute runner for the Sprout Memorial is... you.
Biwa Hayahide, do you intend to run?
Breaking out wide past the final corner—
...She isn't the only one who believes in you.
My theory hasn't... proven anything yet—

...I am worried about Brian's condition.
Would you allow me to go to my sister first?

A "monster" that consistently exceeded every thought, no matter how hard she reasoned.
Yet through her anguish, Biwa Hayahide kept thinking, calculating, persevering—
I still remember the tremor in my heart, the sheer excitement I felt back then.

Biwa Hayahide spoke through her anguish.
...No, she must have been suffering this entire time.
—Now, let us go!!
...He isn't the only one who believes in you.
Wh— What do you mean by that, President?!

Seeing me like that, she must have been worried despite her young age.
One day, Brian invited me to a footrace.

Do you... really believe in me?
That I can reach that realm...

Drowning in notes and books on my bed, spending days on end constructing theories.
Giving it a grandiose name like the "formula for victory."

It's impossible.
I... cannot serve as Brian's replacement.

However... truth be told, we are out of time.
I await your answer, Biwa Hayahide.

I will repeat it as many times as it takes for you to understand.
...Narita Brian has developed a fever.
There's no way I could fill her shoes...!

Listening to Biwa Hayahide's theories made my heart race with excitement.
I couldn't help but want to do everything I could to help bring them to fruition!
Biwa Hayahide, that's simply not—

Summoned by Student Council President Symboli Rudolf,
I headed to the student council room alongside Biwa Hayahide, where—

Everyone was eagerly anticipating the "Monster's" performance in that race,
their eyes sparkling with excitement—until one day...
Trainer...
I know better than anyone just how strong she is!!

...Understood.
I was lacking in consideration as well. Allow me to apologize.

Narita Brian.
She insisted that it had to be you.

In tomorrow's race, I'll run near the front until the final corner.
The lead pack will likely be bunched up tightly.

Even while I was confined to my bed, unable to move,
Brian kept getting faster and faster all on her own.

Not once has "Narita Brian"
ever fit within the bounds of my calculations.

I went to visit Narita Brian with Biwa Hayahide.
The medication had taken effect and she had just fallen asleep, but...
President...!?
